name: Makrodactylus
isnote: A non-pterodactyloid monofenestratan without formal family assignment.
sum: Smallest known adult early monofenestratan, from the Late Jurassic Mörnsheim Formation of Bavaria, named in 2025.
holotype: LF 1370 (Lauer Foundation) — Mörnsheim Formation, Schaudiberg Quarry, Bavaria.
material: Partly disarticulated skeleton: almost all of skull and mandible, vertebrae, girdles, most limbs.
biology: Long skull with no more than seven tooth positions restricted to the jaw tip.
author: Hone et al. 2025
dates_note: Age bracket from the stage named in the literature (ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart); not in PBDB at time of download.
